extras: Requires Node.js 20+ and pnpm 11+ for building; settings are searchable on Obsidian 1.13.0 or later.
intentEvidence: Follow your thoughts. Find your way back.
problem: Users struggle to track the complex, multi-step navigation path they took through a large set of interconnected notes.
summary: Threatback displays the navigation trail followed through notes and infers possible ancestor paths using link context and graph analysis.
